verses.text: Ach in Diosal, ab' in lesal, manh a patikejel tas tzin k'an t'ayach.
Kotanh k'elan t'ayin, tak'wanh t'ayin in k'ana. T'a skal in yahelal swal in b'a t'ayach.
Tzin ib'xik'e yuj xiwelal yuj heb' chuk ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin. Tz'el yaw heb' yuj yajk'olal. Te niwan in yahelal ix yak'kot heb' t'a wib'anh. Yet' wal yowal sk'ol heb' tzin spechan b'eyek' heb'.
Syab' wal sya'il in pixan yuj heb'. Toxo ix jawi smay chamel t'a wib'anh.
Ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'ayin, wan wib'xik'e yuj.
Tzin na'ani, komonok ay in k'axil icha nok' uch, tzam in b'at jenhenhok, tato icha chi' junk'olal am tzin aji.
Tzam in b'at jenhenhok t'a najat, a am laj t'a tzinan lu'um tzin kajnaji.
Tzam in b'at in kol in b'a yuj yowal junok anima icha owal ik'nhab' yaji, xin chi.
Mamin, satkanel heb' chuk, jub'at tas syal heb'. Anhej owal swil t'a yol chonhab' tik, malaj jab'ok yok'elk'olal heb'.
k'uhal t'ak'wal yek' heb' yoymitej chonhab' t'a yib'anh muro. Ay wal chukal t'a yol chonhab' yet' naoj cha'anh es. Ix te juwiel chonhab' yuj heb'.
Komonxonhej sk'ulej chukal heb' t'a yoltak calle yet' ak'oj musansatil.
Tato a heb' komon ajk'o'ol tzin ixtani, tzam techajlaj wu'uj. Tato a mach schichonoch sk'ol t'ayin icha chi' tzin utani, tzam in k'ub'ejel in b'a t'ay.
Okxo tikne'ik, a mach wuk'lew yaji, in wach' k'ol yaji, ha' tzin utan icha tik.
Junnhej ix b'at wet' t'a stemplo Dios. Ix onh lolon t'a amigo'al. Junnhej ix ek' wet' t'a skal heb' anima t'a templo chi'.
Jaokab' juknaj chamel t'a heb' ajk'o'ol yajoch t'ayin. Pitzanokab' heb' tz'emkan heb' b'aj smukjiem heb' chamnak, yujto ay wal och chukal t'a spensar heb' yet' t'a yol spat heb'.
Ha in tik, ha t'a Jehová Dios ol wal in b'a. A' ol in kolanok.
T'a k'inhib'alil, t'a chimk'uhalil yet' t'a yemk'uhalil, ol wal in b'a t'ay t'a skal yal in sat, haxo ol ab'an tas ol wala'.
A' ol in kolanel t'a skal owal. Manh ol in chajoklaj cham yuj, wach'chom tzijtum heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayin.
Ha Dios Yajal t'a masanil tiempo, ha' ol ab'an tas swala', emnakil ol ajkan heb' ajk'ol chi' yuj, yujto max sk'exlaj jab'ok sb'eyb'al heb', max xiwpaxlaj heb' t'ay.
Ha winh wuk'lew chi', ix yik'cha'anh sk'ab' winh t'ayin, wach'chom in wach' k'ol in b'a yet' winh. Max sk'anab'ajejlaj b'aj ix yak' sti' winh yoch wamigo'ok.
k'ununi slolon winh, palta haxo t'a spensar winh, anhej owal snib'ej winh. Te k'ununi syutej winh sloloni, palta icha k'e'en espada te jay ye, icha chi' yaj slolonel winh chi'.
Masanil tas tzin na'a, ol wak'b'at t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová, ha' ol ak'an in tek'anil. Tato k'anab'ajum swutej in b'a t'ay, malaj b'ak'inh ol in scha telwok.

Ach in Diosal, a heb' mak'umcham anima yet' heb' naumk'e es, tzapan ol aj sk'inal heb', manh ol yil-laj nanhalb'ok sk'inal heb'. Ha ach ton ol ak'b'at heb' b'aj smukchaj heb' chamnak. Palta a in tik, tzach wak'och yipok in k'o'ol.
